synopsis: M&S SPICE is a 2023 research-and-industry framework for automotive research, published in peer-reviewed proceedings of the INCOSE International Symposium [f8124, f7699]. It derives the credibility required for a simulation task from that task’s criticality and assesses whether the simulation process can deliver that credibility [f14595, f7699, f7700, f8125]. Alongside SET Level Credible Simulation Process, it addresses validation against physical data at the process level and addresses validity and transfer through credibility documentation [f8126, f8127]. For off-road automatic braking, however, these frameworks offer only a process template: they are not proven for that application and do not specify what physical evidence remains necessary [f8129, f8130, f8128].
